# Support

- **Connect a client.** The [website](https://geo-mcp.abgeo.cloud/) shows each step for
  Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, and VS Code.
- **Run the server yourself.** The [README](../README.md#run-it-yourself) shows Docker
  and Go.
- **A wrong answer or an error.** Open a
  [bug report](https://github.com/abgeo/georgia-mcp/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml).
- **A new source or tool.** Open a
  [proposal](https://github.com/abgeo/georgia-mcp/issues/new?template=feature_request.yml).
- **A vulnerability.** Read the [security policy](SECURITY.md).
